lines.text: The king of Assyria settled people from Babylon and other lands in Samaria, and the LORD sent lions among them.
The king of Assyria sent back a carried-off priest, who came and lived in Jerusalem and taught the settlers.
The people of each nation made their own gods and set them up in the shrines on the high places.
The LORD commanded the Israelites not to worship other gods, but to worship Him, who brought them out of Assyria.
The nations would not listen, worshiped the LORD but also served their idols, and their descendants kept doing the same.
